name: Garlic

schedule.notes: Fall planting, 4 to 6 weeks before ground freezes. Mulch heavily.
Top-dress with compost or balanced fert as tops emerge in spring.
Pull when 3 to 4 lower leaves yellow, others still green. Cure 3 to 4 weeks.

harvest.cues: About half the leaves have yellowed but the plant still has green. Don't wait for full die-back — bulbs split.
harvest.storageNotes: Cure 3 to 4 weeks in shade with airflow. Trim and store at 50 to 60 F with low humidity. Hardneck 4 to 6 months, softneck 6 to 9.

varieties.name: Music
varieties.notes: Big cloves, classic strong flavor. Excellent for cold climates.

varieties.name: German Extra Hardy
varieties.notes: 4 to 6 large cloves per bulb. Very cold-hardy.

varieties.name: Inchelium Red
varieties.notes: Mild, longer storage, no scapes. Best in mild winter climates.

notes: Hardneck for flavor and cold tolerance; softneck for storage and braiding. Plant largest cloves — they grow the biggest bulbs.
